guidelines.content: Carefully review the CLI tool's supported commands and argument formatsvia its --help outputbefore invoking any API action, especially when the command or arguments are not explicitly documented or familiar.
When selecting the latest revision per event from a ledger, use the event_id as the key and retain only the row with the highest revision number for each event_id before applying further filters.

After determining correct filter criteria from a contract or runtime help (status, date, account, etc.), methodically apply filters in the order they are described or logically required before performing aggregates or calculations.

selection: Reviewed from training only, before any held-out evaluation
secondary: Agent turns and rejected service calls; report both even if worse
